title: Smoky Satay Tacos
description: A fusion twist on traditional Mexican tacos, featuring the bold flavors of smoky satay and Malaysian spices.

ingredients.name: Smoked Paprika
ingredients.notes: adds smoky flavor to satay sauce

instructions: 1. Cook the morcilla in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned on both sides.
2. Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
3. In a separate pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
4. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
5. Add the satay sauce and smoked paprika to the pan, whisking constantly.
6. Bring the satay sauce to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes until thickened.
7. Assemble the tacos by slicing the cooked morcilla and placing it onto a warmed tortilla.
8. Spoon the satay sauce over the morcilla and garnish with chopped cilantro.
9. Serve immediately with lime wedges on the side.
